multiplicity: BH over all 20 genus×metric DiD contrasts
interpretation: Joint genus-panel exclusion effect relative to matched full-genus training, adjusted for common-control model difference; training-pool interactions and one-seed model variability remain.
feature_selection: Both newly retrained arms use the same panel-free reselected vocabulary of 9,239 canonical 9-mers. No target genus enters feature selection.
frozen_production_role: Descriptive deployed-model comparator; excluded from primary matched-arm DiD.

secondary_sensitivity.multiplicity: BH separately within20 genus-by-outcome contrasts for each of3 prespecified secondary comparisons
secondary_sensitivity.fixed_epoch: 20 in both arms; independent of validation/test performance; primary uses each arm best validation checkpoint
